Product introductionCore parametersConfiguration optionsProject applications

Product introduction

SC(B)14 and SC(B)18 cast-resin dry-type transformers serve grid distribution, commercial buildings and industrial enterprises. The series supports maximum design capacities up to 8000 kVA, with off-circuit or on-load voltage regulation and intelligent monitoring configurations.

Electrical configuration
HV 10 / 10.5 / 11 kV, tapping ±5% or ±2×2.5%, LV 0.4 kV, vector group Yyn0 or Dyn11. Load losses are identical for SCB18 and SCB14. 630* = 4% impedance variant.

Configuration options

Voltage regulation

Project applications

Buildings, industry and distribution

Dry-type transformers serve load-centre installations in commercial buildings, industrial facilities and distribution networks. Select capacity, enclosure and cooling around the actual load and installation environment.
